pages.text: With CC:Tweaked installed, a computer, turtle or redstone relay can read a conduit’s bundled signals. Put the receiver against the configured endpoint and use the computer side that touches it.

Set colors on the redstone route. On a computer whose back touches the conduit, read redstone.getBundledInput("back"). Use testBundledInput with a color to check a single channel. Verify the matching analog output separately.
